answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital lockup. By forcing nodes to commit collateral, the system ensures that an attacker cannot create a hollow identity without incurring substantial financial risk. Just as a bee seeks nectar in a vast meadow, an agent must harvest sufficient economic stake to gain voting rights, making the cost of spinning up numerous fake identities prohibitively expensive and economically irrational.
